California Valveworks browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive fuzz browse by enclosure pedal California Valveworks The Bone Tender Published on August 2, 2007 California Valveworks fuzz pedal Information California Valveworks Bone Tender (n.)(bōn tend-r) - 1. fuzz - 2. the original distortion pedal. squeezes vintage sounding buzz and fizz out of three vintage germanium transistors - 3. a favorite effect of Jimmy Page, The Yardbirds, and David Bowie. A truly special creation: True vintage fuzz from a true vintage circuit. A super broad fuzz sweep for total control. And super cool retro graphics.
